name: DEL Payment Button for Swish
author: David Elfström Lilja

sections.description:
DEL Payment Button for Swish adds a Swish payment to any page. The visitor picks an amount and gets a QR code with the number, the amount and the message already filled in. On a phone, the visitor instead gets a button that opens the Swish app with the same details.

The plugin is made for associations and small sites that want to take a membership fee, a gift or an event fee without setting up a shop. You need no WooCommerce, no Swish Handel agreement and no API.

Swish is a Swedish mobile payment service, so the plugin is mainly useful for sites in Sweden. The plugin is ready for translation, and a Swedish translation is planned.

How it works

  1. You enter your Swish number under Settings, Payment Button for Swish.
  2. You create a button with the amounts to choose from, for example Regular 250 kr, Junior 100 kr and Family 350 kr.
  3. You paste the shortcode of the button on a page, or pick the button in the Payment Button for Swish block.
  4. The visitor picks an amount and scans the QR code, or taps Open Swish on a phone.
  5. You see the payment in your bank or in the Swish app, as usual.

Features

  • Fixed amounts with names, shown as buttons or as a drop-down list.
  • Free amount for gifts and fundraising, with a lowest and a highest amount.
  • Message with placeholders for the chosen amount and the year, for example “Membership {year} {choice}”. The year changes by itself at New Year.
  • The QR code is created on your own server. No calls to other services.
  • An Open Swish button on phones. Computers show the QR code, and tablets show both.
  • Number, amount and message are also shown as text, for those who prefer to type them.
  • Several buttons on the same page, each with its own amounts and, if needed, its own Swish number.
  • Shortcode and block. The shortcode works in any page builder, for example below a membership form.
  • Follows the font and text colour of your theme. Colour, size and alignment can be set for each button.
  • Works with a keyboard and with a screen reader.
  • No personal data is collected or stored, and the plugin creates no database table.

Examples of use

  • Membership fee in an association, with different amounts for regular members, juniors and families.
  • Gift or donation with a free amount.
  • Fundraising for a specific purpose, with its own message.
  • Registration fee or ticket for an event.

What the plugin does not do

The plugin has no contact with Swish. It cannot see whether a payment has been made, and it does not mark anything as paid. The message in the payment shows what it is for, and you check the payments in your bank or in the Swish app.

If you sell products in WooCommerce and want Swish as a payment method at checkout, there is DEL Swish Checkout.

Which Swish service?

Which Swish service you may use depends on the terms of your bank. You are responsible for following them.

Trademark

Swish is a trademark of Getswish AB. DEL Payment Button for Swish is an independent plugin from DEL Plugins and is not made or endorsed by Getswish AB.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins, Add Plugin and search for “DEL Payment Button for Swish”. Install and activate.
  2. Go to Settings, Payment Button for Swish and enter your Swish number.
  3. Choose Add button. Enter a heading, the amounts and a message, and save.
  4. Copy the shortcode that is shown, for example [del_payment_button id="member"], and paste it where the button should appear. In the block editor you can instead add the Payment Button for Swish block and pick the button in the list.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

No. The plugin works on a plain WordPress site.

Do I need a Swish Handel agreement or a certificate?

No. The plugin uses no API. It creates a QR code and a link that fill in the payment in the visitor’s Swish app.

Can I use a private Swish number?

Technically the plugin works with Swish numbers that start with 123 and with mobile numbers. Which Swish service you may use depends on the terms of your bank. You are responsible for following them.

How do I see who has paid?

In your bank or in the Swish app, where the sender, the amount and the message are shown. The plugin collects nothing about the payer. If you need to know who a payment is for, place the button below a form where the person signs up first.

How long can the message be?

Swish allows 50 characters. Longer messages are cut, and characters that Swish does not accept are removed. The settings page shows what the message becomes for the first amount.

Can the visitor change the amount in the app?

The QR code and the link hold the amount that was chosen on the page. For gifts where the visitor decides, turn on free amount.

Does it work with öre?

Yes, for fixed amounts. If you enter 99,50 the QR code holds exactly that amount. A free amount is in whole kronor.

Does it work on cached pages?

Yes. The QR codes for the fixed amounts are part of the page. Only a free amount is fetched from your server, after the visitor has typed it.

Can I have several buttons on the same page?

Yes, as many as you like. Each button has its own amounts.

Is anything sent to another service?

No. The QR code is created on your own server, and the plugin loads no files from other sites.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

The settings and the buttons are removed. The plugin stores nothing else.
